tasks.title: Update README documentation for new init flow and instructions.md
tasks.description:
Update README.md to document the changes:

1. Update the `ralph init` section to describe the new interactive property-by-property flow (mention that it prompts for each ralph.json property with defaults, and that re-running init on an existing project lets you update fields).

2. Add documentation for .ralph/instructions.md:
   - What it is: personal prompt instructions injected into execution agent system prompts
   - How it differs from CLAUDE.md: personal (gitignored) vs project-level (committed)
   - That it only applies to execution agents, not planning
   - Created during `ralph init` or manually

3. Update the ralph.json config table if one exists, or add one showing all properties and their defaults.

4. Update the per-project data layout section to include instructions.md:
   ```
   .ralph/
   ├── tasks.json
   ├── tasks.completed.json
   ├── planning-notes.md
   └── instructions.md          # Personal agent preferences (gitignored)
   ```
tasks.notes: Updated README with: (1) interactive init flow description with re-init note, (2) new Personal Agent Instructions section explaining instructions.md vs CLAUDE.md, (3) truncateText field added to config table and example JSON, (4) instructions.md added to per-project data layout, (5) tip added in Tips section.
